The instant petition has been filed under Article 226 & 227 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C.') on behalf of petitioner seeking issuance of writ/order/directions in the nature of mandamus thereby directing the learned Trial Court to expedite the proceedings of the criminal case no. 6161 of 2019 pending before the Court of learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Dwarka, Court, New Delhi arising out of FIR bearing no.
298/2018 registered at Police Station Palam Village, Delhi for offence punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC').
